description:
- Renamed two patches to Material You and Material search. If they show as unselected in Morphe Manager, select them again.

Import the `.mpp` into Morphe Manager and patch Boost for Reddit 1.14.3 (`com.rubenmayayo.reddit`). Recheck patch selections after the display-name cleanup. No Boost APK is included.

patches.name: Bottom gallery action buttons
patches.description: Compact image and gallery action pills with navigation insets; move video download beside the other actions.

patches.name: Expand inline comment media
patches.description: Double tap an existing inline image/GIF to expand it in place; single tap retains Boost's viewer.

patches.name: HTTP/2 Reddit connection
patches.description: Connect to Reddit over HTTP/2, with HTTP/1.1 as a fallback.

patches.name: Hide horizontal comment dividers
patches.description: Make horizontal comment and load-more dividers transparent while retaining spacing and vertical thread indicators.

patches.name: Hold to peek at media
patches.description: Hold a loaded post image or inline comment image/GIF to preview it; release to dismiss.

patches.name: Home account avatar
patches.description: Show the account avatar beside Home and in the bottom pill, with subreddit icons beside community titles; retain sorting and navigation.

patches.name: Improved online check
patches.description: Let requests run when Android reports a restricted app's network as blocked.

patches.name: Inline flairs
patches.description: Move post flairs in line with the post details, and keep flair text readable.

patches.name: Instant saved login
patches.description: Use a saved login that is still valid straight away, and renew it in the background.

patches.name: Material You
patches.description: Wallpaper-based themes, cards, side panel, empty screens, compact metadata and glass surfaces.

patches.name: Material dialogs
patches.description: Float option menus above the bottom edge like the bottom bar.

patches.name: Material loading animation
patches.description: Wallpaper-coloured Material 3 Expressive shapes for pull-to-refresh and indeterminate loading wheels; retain native refresh actions.

patches.name: Material notices
patches.description: Show Boost's toasts as Material 3 notices above the bottom bar.

patches.name: Material search
patches.description: Fill the empty search page with your feeds and subscriptions in collapsible Material 3 sections.

patches.name: Parallel content loading
patches.description: Load feeds, comments and posts in parallel instead of one background task at a time.

patches.name: Polish comment layout
patches.description: Group avatar, username, points, time and awards in a compact flowing header; retain native actions and flair.

patches.name: Polish media viewer
patches.description: Restore native media rendering and close the viewer as soon as a swipe passes its threshold.

patches.name: Predictive back navigation
patches.description: Enable Android's predictive Back animations across supported screens, preserving draft prompts, drawers and browser history.

patches.name: Remove startup request queue
patches.description: Stop spacing Reddit requests a second apart, and pace them again when Reddit reports a low budget.

patches.name: Show post in comments header
patches.description: Show r/subreddit and the post title throughout the comments screen, preserving native menu and search actions.

patches.name: Sliding screen transitions
patches.description: New screens slide over the one below, which drifts back slightly.

patches.name: Smaller first page
patches.description: Ask for 25 posts on the first page of a feed. Later pages keep their size.

patches.name: Swipe comment actions
patches.description: Swipe left by distance: short upvotes, medium downvotes, long replies. Preview the selected icon and release to act.

patches.name: Swipe post actions
patches.description: Swipe posts left through upvote, downvote, save and hide; rows follow your finger.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Use your phone's system font for posts, comments, names and the rest of the app. Boost's own font settings stop applying.

release_notes:
Boost for Reddit:
- Flair text now sits in the middle of its pill instead of near the bottom.
- Shikify Settings uses Material 3 switches.
- Changing a Loading setting offers to restart Boost so it applies straight away.

Import the `.mpp` into Morphe Manager and patch your own copy of Boost for Reddit 1.14.3 (`com.rubenmayayo.reddit`). No Boost APK is included.
repoDescription: Material 3 and Material You patches for Android apps, for use with Morphe
